# Generated nanopb descriptors for the leaf's OTLP trace path
# (docs/leaf-concentrator-design.md §2.4): common, resource, trace and the
# trace collector service. Metrics and logs are not generated (design §1.3).
#
# Generated by ci/scripts/regen-protos.sh --nanopb-generator with the options
# in leaf/nanopb/otlp_trace.options. CI verifies zero diff on every PR
# (ci.yml, job: regen-check).
#
# DO NOT edit files under gen/nanopb/ by hand; run regen-protos.sh instead.
#
# Like third_party/nanopb/CMakeLists.txt, this file is C-only and reads no
# variable of the main project, so the leaf's standalone build can add it.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

add_library(microtel_nanopb_gen STATIC
    opentelemetry/proto/common/v1/common.pb.c
    opentelemetry/proto/resource/v1/resource.pb.c
    opentelemetry/proto/trace/v1/trace.pb.c
    opentelemetry/proto/collector/trace/v1/trace_service.pb.c)

# Generated sources use:
#   #include "opentelemetry/proto/.../foo.pb.h"   resolved from gen/nanopb/
#   #include <pb.h>                                resolved from microtel_nanopb
target_include_directories(microtel_nanopb_gen
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}>)

set_target_properties(microtel_nanopb_gen PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# microtel_nanopb carries the rename header (-include) and the PB_* macros as
# PUBLIC options, so linking it applies both here. The generated descriptors
# (`opentelemetry_proto_*_msg` and their `_field_info` / `_submsg_info`
# tables) are renamed to microtel_pb_opentelemetry_proto_* by the same header
# (design §2.5, §9 decision 9); gen/nanopb/ stays byte-identical to the
# generator's output, which is what regen-check asserts.
target_link_libraries(microtel_nanopb_gen PUBLIC microtel_nanopb)

# -w suppresses warnings in generated code.
target_compile_options(microtel_nanopb_gen PRIVATE -w)
